query.User: I need to find a good Chinese restaurant in New York and then send its address to my friend Bob.

function.name: ShareLocation
function.description: Send your location to a contact. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

function.name: ReserveRestaurant
function.description: Make a table reservation at a restaurant. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

function.name: FindRestaurants
function.description: Find restaurants by location and by category. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.
